title: Concept: Cheque return reason exposed
description: A cheque return reason code with the drawer's account in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The return reason says why an instrument bounced, and a string of them is the credit history of the drawer, which the payee should not be able to read from the App.
applicability: Deployments that render a cheque return reason code with the drawer's account into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The return reason says why an instrument bounced, and a string of them is the credit history of the drawer, which the payee should not be able to read from the App.
